nvitk.transform.rotation
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.transform.rotation

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Detect and correct rigid Z-rotation misalignment between image grids.

.. py:function:: correct_z_rotation(image: nvitk.types.Image | None, affine: numpy.ndarray, rotation_degrees: float)

   Rotate *image* and its *affine* by ``-rotation_degrees`` around the Z axis.

   :param image: Optional :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` to rotate. If ``None`` only the
                 affine is updated.
   :param affine: 4x4 voxel-to-world affine (NumPy).
   :param rotation_degrees: Rotation to undo (the function applies ``-rotation_degrees``). A fast
                            path is used for |180°|.

   :returns: Rotated image (or ``None``) and updated affine.
   :rtype: (Image | None, np.ndarray)


.. py:function:: check_and_correct_rotation(pet_affine: numpy.ndarray | Any, mri_affine: numpy.ndarray | Any, pet_image: nvitk.types.Image | None = None, *, threshold_deg: float = 5.0) -> RotationAnalysis

   Compare two affines and optionally correct Z-rotation on *pet_image*.

   Uses the normalized-column relative rotation ``R_mri @ R_pet.T``; the Z
   rotation is the ``arctan2`` of the 2x2 upper-left block. A near-180°
   reflection case is detected via the signs of ``R_relative``.

   :param pet_affine: 4x4 voxel-to-world affines. CuPy arrays are materialized to NumPy.
   :param mri_affine: 4x4 voxel-to-world affines. CuPy arrays are materialized to NumPy.
   :param pet_image: Optional PET image to correct when rotation exceeds *threshold_deg*.
   :param threshold_deg: Tolerance (degrees) under which correction is skipped.
